details: Sea level rise sections are framed against the OPC scenarios: the projected rise at 2050 and 2100 for each recommended scenario, the full Appendix F table on this page, and every snapshot carrying its gauge's thirteen decades. No exposure figure, and no crossing year, moved; the version stays 1.

The version in development. Orange County was first computed from real data in Phase 2 (block-level areal apportionment of people and jobs to the flood and sea level rise extents); Phase 3 extended the same method to all 27 counties (FEMA flood zones found through the political-jurisdiction layer, sea level rise polygons read from every NOAA regional file a county touches, each county measured on a projection centred on it). The version stays 1 until the tool is published; from then on any change that could move a figure increments it.
